headline: Nigerian Fintech Cyber Incidents Spotlight Gaps in Threat-Sharing System
summary: Reports of cyberattacks on multiple Nigerian fintech firms have elevated industry concern regarding cybersecurity preparedness and collaborative defense protocols.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest digital payments hub; system-wide cybersecurity vulnerabilities pose operational and regulatory risks for emerging financial platforms.

impacts.name: Nigeria Fintech Sector
impacts.why: Unverified breaches expose gaps in industry-wide cybersecurity defense and regulatory compliance.
